---
title: "Troubleshooting"
---

## Before asking for help

Save these details:

- Exact command or SLURM script
- Job ID and complete log file
- Software and database version
- Input and output paths
- Exact error message

## Common checks

| Problem area | Check first |
|---|---|
| Biowulf job fails | Resource request, job log, quota, module, and paths |
| No input files found | File names, directory path, read permission, and sample sheet |
| Search output looks wrong | FASTA version, parameters, FDR, and raw-file assignment |
| Downstream analysis fails | Required columns, metadata names, configuration path, and input-output match |
